chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a quiet luminous entrance: a reversed-cymbal swell breathes in, a high glass chime rings and echoes into the dark, a deep pad wakes beneath}
positive_styles: suspended C major with a Lydian F sharp glint
soft bell-pad lead with long shimmering tones
lush sustained suspended string pad chords
a single soft reversed-cymbal swell every four bars, no beat
vast sacred ice cavern lit from within, awe and stillness

chunks.text:
[Main Theme]
{slow bell entries: a rising lift G, C, D blooming into a sustained suspended chord, then a descending settle that dissolves into echo; glassy arpeggios turning above}
positive_styles: suspended C major with a Lydian F sharp glint

chunks.text:

chunks.text:
[Bridge]
{contrast: a hushed dip to A minor and F major, the bells fall silent and only the pad and a low solemn line remain, like midnight held in the ice, then a swell rises}
